fusions.name: Off My Ledge
fusions.desc: A head-down butt, rank with billy musk, that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 9 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Eats Anything
fusions.desc: Bites the first enemy within 3 tiles and deals 16 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Butted Right Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooves Dug In
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
